name: Convex-Geometry Ideals Are PC-Minor-Closed
statement: Every nonempty pc-minor of a convex-geometry ideal graph is again a convex-geometry ideal graph.
proof: By the exact closure theorem, $\mathsf{Icg}$ is already the pc-minor closure of learning spaces. A further sequence of projections and conditionings concatenates with the first sequence and stays in the same closure.
